title: CONVERT ( 1.2345, CURRENCY ) / CONVERT ( 2, CURRENCY ) is the decimal number 0.61725
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CONVERT ( 1.2345, CURRENCY ) / CONVERT ( 2, CURRENCY ) )

source.quote: When the currency is at the numerator of a division, the result might be rounded to the closest value that can be represented in a currency data type
source.supports: the examples that follow give 1.2345 / 2 as 0.6173 for a currency over an integer and 0.61725 when the denominator is a currency

source.quote: The result is always decimal, unless a currency is divided by an integer or by a decimal; in this case, the result is currency
source.supports: an integer divided by a currency is a decimal number; a currency divided by an integer is a currency

notes: The contrast to INTEGER / CURRENCY: with a currency denominator the result keeps the fifth decimal, so it is not a currency.
